messages:
Alice Chen: FYI — canary (rollout-2026-03) started at 03:00 UTC. We're seeing a prompt-eval quality delta spike at 03:05. Holding warm window until we decide next step.
Deploy-bot: Canary ID: canary-2026-03-11-1, traffic=5%, region=us-west-2, model=v3.2-quant. Automated evals: baseline->canary delta = -4.8% (summarizer suite).
Emily QA: Oof. How noisy is the signal? sample size?
Alice Chen: sample n=1200 (subset of traffic). Failure rate increased from 2.1% -> 6.9% on prompt-suite A. Pretty consistent across runs.
Frank K: Do we have quick diffs for top failure categories? bad formatting, hallucination, truncation?
Alice Chen: Top buckets: 1) factual-accuracy regressions +3.2pp, 2) length-truncation +1.1pp, 3) response-style drift +0.5pp. Mostly accuracy.
Devon SRE: Rolling back canary will flip ~5% traffic; no infra risk. If we pin, we avoid rollbacks for infra churn but may keep degraded quality for those users.
Carlos PM: Any user-facing incidents yet? metrics or alerts?
Deploy-bot: No customer incidents. Error budget OK. Latency/CPU normal.
Emily QA: Suggestion: pin the canary route to previous pinned model (v3.1.7) for warm window users while we bisect. That minimizes user exposure.
Frank K: Agree. Pin gives time to triage root cause of quantized path. If bisect points to quantization, we can patch and re-promote.
Alice Chen: If we pin, need approval from release lead + SRE. @devon_sre can you confirm operational constraints?
Devon SRE: Confirmed — we can pin traffic routing for canary to v3.1.7 with zero infra change; takes ~2 mins to update route and 5 mins for all gateways to observe. No rollback required.
Carlos PM: Do we need to notify customers in the window? small cohort only. I'd prefer a short note in release notes and update status page if we see any downstream issues.
Emily QA: I'll start a bisect job and run targeted prompt-suite slices across quantized checkpoints. ETA 90m for initial results.
Frank K: OK. Decision: pin canary route -> v3.1.7 and run bisect. If bisect shows no single kernel issue within 2h, escalate to rollback.
Alice Chen: Action items:
- @deploy-bot: execute route pin to v3.1.7 for canary-2026-03-11-1 now.
- @emily_qa: start bisect and post preliminary findings to this thread.
- @frank_k + @devon_sre: prepare rollback plan (steps & timeline) in case bisect fails.
Deploy-bot: Route update queued: set canary-2026-03-11-1 -> model v3.1.7. Requestor: alice.chen. ETA apply: 03:18 UTC.
Alice Chen: Thanks. Will watch evals. If any worsening or user incident, we'll roll forward to rollback plan immediately. :eyes:
Emily QA: Started bisect job 03:12 UTC. Will post top diffs 03:50 UTC.
Devon SRE: Rollback playbook link: https://internal/release/rollback-playbook — team on standby.
Frank K: If bisect points to a tokenization regression in the quantized weights, we might need a hotfix quant build. That has a ~4h turnaround. Keep that as option B.
Carlos PM: I'll draft a short blurb for release notes: "Canary briefly pinned due to eval delta; no customer impact observed."
Alice Chen: Closing decision: pin in place, monitoring. Reopen thread with bisect results.
Carlos PM: ack.
Emily QA: posting first pass in 38m.
